message:
We’ve all been there—suddenly scrambling for supplies during an emergency and realizing we only have half a flashlight and some expired granola bars. 😅 It’s a comedy of errors that’s all too relatable! That’s why we think it’s super helpful to have a solid list of essentials on hand. The Red Cross has put together some great tips on what to include in a survival kit, making it a little easier to be ready for whatever life throws our way. 

So, let’s avoid the last-minute scramble together! What’s your favorite tip or trick for staying prepared?
